reasoning: The two attempts are functionally the same. Each adds a Price field to BlockTypes and adds a hook on PlacementServerService that runs after every other check and before the cell is marked occupied. Each also adds a server-only Implementation mediator that requires both services, so there is no cycle. The only differences are cosmetic. A puts the mediator in CurrencySystem and exports a nullable handler type. B puts it in PlacementSystem and writes a more explicit doc comment on the setter. Both failed luau-lsp with the same harness path error. Neither difference changes correctness or how mergeable the code is.
